name: tw-law-ctx-bench
description: A benchmark of Taiwanese legal-context question answering designed to evaluate models' ability to retrieve, understand, and ground answers in law texts (statutes, cases, and regulations). It measures how well models can use long or domain-specific context to produce legally relevant, accurate responses. Tasks typically require factual extraction, citation grounding, and concise legal reasoning in Chinese.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark focused on Taiwanese law with limited but growing use among legal/NLP researchers working on Chinese legal text.
